question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin, an official external ClawHub provider, or kept as documented custom-provider configuration for now?
rationale: The current provider SDK can express this provider, but OpenClaw policy keeps core lean and treats optional provider bundling, official ownership, and live-key validation as maintainer product decisions.

options.title: Official external provider first
options.body: Build LongCat as an official external provider package discoverable through ClawHub, with later bundled promotion only if maintainers accept the core-package cost.

options.title: Bundle in core now
options.body: Add LongCat under extensions with native onboarding and catalog support, accepting the ongoing bundled-provider maintenance and release surface.

options.title: Keep custom-provider docs
options.body: Leave LongCat on manual custom-provider configuration until demand, ownership, or API maturity is clearer.

recommendation.title: Official external provider first
recommendation.body: Build LongCat as an official external provider package discoverable through ClawHub, with later bundled promotion only if maintainers accept the core-package cost.
